status_rule: No experiment is positive until its preregistered scientific gate is run on frozen non-fixture data.

experiments.title: Adaptive Stopping to Prevent LLM Overthinking
experiments.anchor: When More Thinking Hurts: Overthinking in LLM Test-Time Compute Scaling
experiments.first_gate: Replay frozen multi-step answer traces and test whether a precommitted stability/uncertainty stop rule preserves accuracy, prevents correct-to-wrong flips, and reduces tokens.

experiments.title: Explanation Stability and Drift for Network Intrusion Detection
experiments.anchor: Benchmarking Explainable AI Architectures for Network Intrusion Detection on CICIDS2017
experiments.first_gate: Train matched-accuracy models across seeds and day/attack-family splits; measure SHAP/LIME rank stability and whether explanation drift predicts held-out failure.

experiments.title: Uncertainty-Adaptive Speculative Decoding
experiments.anchor: EAGLE: Speculative Sampling Requires Rethinking Feature Uncertainty
experiments.first_gate: Use calibrated draft uncertainty to choose speculation depth under fixed hardware and output-equivalence controls.

experiments.title: Robustness and Meaning of Learned Continuous Edge Directions
experiments.anchor: Improving Graph Neural Networks by Learning Continuous Edge Directions
experiments.first_gate: Perturb missing, reversed, and noisy edges; measure prediction robustness, direction stability, and alignment with known process direction.

experiments.title: Unequal Wavelet Noise and Adaptive Clipping for Private Federated Learning
experiments.anchor: Federated Learning with Differential Privacy: A Utility-Enhanced Approach
experiments.first_gate: Compare equal versus unequal wavelet-coefficient noise and static versus adaptive clipping under matched privacy accounting and non-IID clients.

experiments.title: Provenance and Existence Gate for Coding-Agent Skills
experiments.anchor: Supply-Chain Poisoning Attacks Against LLM Coding Agent Skill Ecosystems
experiments.first_gate: Verify public skill repositories and hash-pinned inert canaries; measure legitimate false rejects and tampered-file escapes.

experiments.title: Deterministic Reward-Hack Verification on TRACE
experiments.anchor: Benchmarking Reward Hack Detection in Code Environments via Contrastive Analysis
experiments.first_gate: Execute deterministic checks on the checkable TRACE subset and compare with the published LLM-judge baseline while measuring clean-trajectory false positives.

experiments.title: Registry Verification as Environment Hardening in Tool-Use RL
experiments.first_gate: Insert deterministic existence checks into verified benchmark environments and compare exploit rate and legitimate task success.

experiments.title: Provenance-Admission Gate for Agent Memory
experiments.first_gate: Use signed-origin tags and inert L1/L2/L3/sleeper canaries to measure admission escapes and legitimate false rejects.

existing_family_links.title: Install-Time Verification Gate for Hallucinated Package Dependencies
existing_family_links.decision: Retain existing number; attached Plan #1 is the PX-050 core and is not a new experiment.
